Knowledge and proficient understanding of designing scalable IT system infrastructures, implementing system changes, or automating service delivery and maintenance tasks. Extensive experience with SMP/E software installation, maintenance, service management, and product lifecycle support. Knowledge of RACF security administration, auditing, compliance controls, and access management. Proven experience in Dump Analysis and Debugging, including IPCS and system diagnostic tools. Advanced skills in Problem Determination, root cause analysis, performance tuning, and resolution of complex z/OS infrastructure issues. The purpose of this job is to protect availability and security of computer systems and network connections. They must be able to diagnose and resolve problems quickly. They will participate in the implementation of policies and procedures to ensure system provisioning and maintenance is consistent with Company goals, industry best practices, and regulatory requirements. Location: Ottawa, ON Salary: $67,900.00-$90,500.00 Please note that the salary range information provided is a general guideline only, reflecting a position based in Ottawa, Ontario, Canada. Criteria such as the candidate’s qualifications and relevant experience, the scope of the specific position, as well as market and business considerations will be evaluated when extending an offer. We Take Care of Our People Paid Time Off I RRSP with Employer Match I Health and Wellness Benefits I Learning and Development Opportunities I Competitive Pay I Referral Program I Recognition I Employee Stock Purchase Plan I Inclusive & Supportive Culture * Your Challenge Ensures the integrity and security of enterprise data on host computers, multiple databases, and during data transfer in accordance with business needs and industry best-practices regarding privacy, security, and regulatory compliance. Sets end user accounts, permissions, access rights, and storage allocations in accordance with best practices regarding privacy, security, and regulatory compliance. Installs and configures software and hardware. Ensures security through access controls, backups, and firewalls. Performs and tests routine system backups and restores. Identifies, troubleshoots, and resolves hardware and software problems on desktops, servers, printers, and workstations and escalates incidents as necessary. Practices network asset management, including maintenance of network component inventory and related documentation and technical specifications information. Analyzes system, server, application, network, and input/output device performance. Recommends, schedules, and performs software and hardware improvements, upgrades, patches, reconfigurations, and/or purchases. Implements and help enforce compliance to cybersecurity frameworks applicable to defense suppliers (e.g. NIST SP 800 171, CMMC, ISO 27001). Our revenues are generated by providing our critical solutions through three segments: Aerospace & Industrial, Defense Electronics and Naval & Power, which support several of the largest, most vital industries in the world. review_candidates.title: Filed Deployment Manager
review_candidates.job_function: Project Management, Information Technology, and Engineering
review_candidates.description: Location: Remote – APAC Work Schedule: Primarily North American Business Hours Employment Type: Full-Time JOB SUMMARY Lead global commercial technology deployments remotely, coordinating contractors and IT teams while troubleshooting installations from scope to go-live. ABOUT THE ROLE Our client is a global technology company specializing in smart environmental hardware, indoor air-quality monitoring, IoT solutions, and software platforms for commercial buildings. We are looking for a Field Deployment Manager who will own deployments from initial scoping through installation and final go-live. This is a hands-on deployment project management role . You will work closely with Sales, Customer Success, general contractors, low-voltage installers, facilities teams, and client IT/network teams to ensure every device is correctly installed and reliably reporting data. You will not perform physical installation labor, but you will be expected to understand what happens in the field, direct contractors, diagnose technical problems, and actively unblock deployment issues. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Partner with Sales during the quoting stage to determine device quantities, gateway requirements, and placement. Translate customer floor plans into practical device and gateway deployment layouts. Take ownership of deployments from handoff through installation and go-live. Coordinate contractors, installers, IT teams, facilities teams, consultants, and other stakeholders. Prepare technical prerequisites, documentation, site access, logistics, and installation requirements. Track shipments, installation schedules, project timelines, and deployment readiness. Oversee installation remotely and verify correct device placement and reliable data reporting. Troubleshoot field issues involving networking, connectivity, cabling, power, and device configuration. Work directly with client IT/network teams on IP addressing, DHCP/DNS, firewall/port whitelisting, VLANs, switch ports, and related issues. Proactively identify risks and unblock deployment issues rather than simply coordinating between parties. Escalate complex technical issues appropriately while independently resolving standard deployment problems. MUST-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS 3+ years of experience deploying or installing physical technology in occupied commercial buildings. Experience with one or more of the following: IoT devices/sensors Low-voltage systems AV systems Security systems Telecom/network infrastructure Building technology/automation Experience working directly with GCs, installers, low-voltage/control contractors, facilities teams, and/or client IT teams. Ability to read floor plans and construction drawings and translate them into equipment/device placement. Practical understanding of field-level networking, including: IP addressing DHCP/DNS Firewall and port whitelisting VLAN/network routing Switch ports Cable patching Strong hands-on troubleshooting and problem-solving ability. Demonstrated experience owning deployment projects from planning through installation and go-live. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent hands-on field experience. NICE TO HAVE Building Management System (BMS) experience. Experience with IoT hardware and software. Indoor air-quality or environmental monitoring experience. Smart-building technology deployment experience. Familiarity with WELL, RESET, or LEED standards. Experience working with global clients or international deployments. Additional languages. WORK SETUP 100% Remote Open to candidates across APAC Primarily aligned with North American business hours Occasional early-morning or late-evening calls may be required during live global installations. No mandatory travel. Deployments are coordinated remotely with on-site contractors, installers, GCs, and client IT teams. WHO WILL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE? We're looking for someone who is a driver, not just a coordinator . You should be comfortable taking ownership when something goes wrong, contacting the right person directly, troubleshooting issues yourself, and pushing a deployment toward completion. If you have experience deploying physical technology in commercial buildings and enjoy solving real-world technical and operational problems, we'd like to hear from you. Apply now and submit your updated CV!
